name: TruB pseudouridine synthase family member 1

function.text: TRUB1 is the approved symbol for TruB pseudouridine synthase family member 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in pre-miRNA binding; pseudouridine synthase activity; mRNA pseudouridine synthesis.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Bladder urothelial carcinoma; Clear cell renal cell carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: TRUB1 encodes TruB pseudouridine synthase family member 1. It mediates pseudouridylation of mRNAs with the consensus sequence 5'-GUUCNANNC-3', harboring a stem-loop structure. It constitutes the major pseudouridine synthase acting on mRNAs. It also catalyzes pseudouridylation of some tRNAs, including synthesis of pseudouridine(55) from uracil-55, in the psi GC loop of a subset of tRNAs.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TRUB1 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, pancreatic adenocarcinoma, and bladder urothelial carcinoma.
